useCase: resin body: a clear SLA shell and a black SLA face over a black PETG skeleton that carries every piece of electronics

process.shell: JLCPCB SLA, transparent resin (8001-class), 2.0 mm walls, clear
process.face: JLCPCB SLA, tough black resin (8228-class), 2.5 mm plate, 3.0 mm raised lens bar
process.skeleton: JLCPCB MJF, nylon PA12, black - tough where resin is brittle, and it takes heat-set inserts
process.fasteners: 4 x M2.5 countersunk through the face into M2.5 brass heat-set inserts in the nylon skeleton; 4 x M2 into M2 inserts for the XIAO clamps. No thread in any resin part.

staged: sliding lens cover and its track

releaseChecks.name: the depth stack still sums to the body depth
releaseChecks.details: face 2.5 + skeleton 2.5 + camera/XIAO stack 11.5 + header 14 + margin 1.4 + bay 14.6 + module 13.8 + foam 1.2 + door 4 = 65.5; the module's PCB back lands at 46.5, the same plane as the field body's

releaseChecks.name: the envelope is smaller than the field body's, in the walls and not the stack
releaseChecks.details: 125 x 82 x 65.5 against 131 x 90 x 65.5: 6 mm of width and 8 mm of height, from 2 mm resin walls where PETG needed 6.0. Depth is set by the electronics and does not move - both bodies grew 0.9 mm when the camera's stand-off stopped being chosen and started being derived.

releaseChecks.name: the camera reaches its lens hole
releaseChecks.details: board back at Z=16.5 less the stack's 15 mm puts the lens face at Z=1.50: through the 2.5 mm skeleton plate and 1 mm into the face's cell, which is open air behind its bore

releaseChecks.name: the module's PCB seats on the skeleton with the fold behind it
releaseChecks.details: 3.9 mm of stand-off takes the module's 3.5 mm PCB with 0.4 mm left for the folded ribbon, out of a 7 mm ribbon

releaseChecks.name: the module fits the cavity with float on every side
releaseChecks.details: 121.0 x 78.0 mm cavity around a 117.01 x 69.41 module: 1.99 mm a side in X, 4.30 in Y

releaseChecks.name: shell walls are at or over the bureau's recommended minimum
releaseChecks.details: 2 mm, against 1.0 mm minimum and 2.0 recommended for JLCPCB SLA in 8001

releaseChecks.name: skeleton is one part
releaseChecks.details: 1 connected component(s): one solid

releaseChecks.name: shell is one part
releaseChecks.details: 1 connected component(s): one solid

releaseChecks.name: face is one part
releaseChecks.details: 1 connected component(s): one solid

releaseChecks.name: all four lens bores are open through the skeleton
the lens row is on the measured 22.00 mm pitch
releaseChecks.details: pitches 22.000, 22.000, 22.000 mm, collinear on Y 39.00

releaseChecks.name: the assembled face and skeleton pass the design field on every lens
releaseChecks.details: 79.5-degree diagonal clear on the tightest of the four, against the 78-degree design figure (the OV3660's real field is MEASURE_REQUIRED)

releaseChecks.name: the face and skeleton block every path to a sensor but the cell
releaseChecks.details: light paths beside each cell, face/skeleton: 100%/100%, 100%/100%, 100%/100%, 100%/100% solid. The clear shell can light up without a sensor seeing it, which is what lets the firmware's cover-closed test read dark.

releaseChecks.name: all four standoff sockets take the brass and grip it at the floor
releaseChecks.details: Ø3.5 brass enters all 4 sockets to the floor and is gripped in 4: Ø4.20 mouth closing to Ø3.60 over 2 mm

releaseChecks.name: the standoff pattern is the drawing's, on its unmeasured centre
releaseChecks.details: 61.9 x 54.8 between centres, of Ø3.5 x 3.3 brass, pattern centre 9.3 mm left of module centre. Diameter and height MEASURED, pitch from the drawing, offset PROVISIONAL and shared with the field body - so a paper check there settles it here too.

releaseChecks.name: the standoff pitch and the caliper span across the standoffs agree
releaseChecks.details: 61.9 x 54.8 between centres plus Ø3.5 of brass is 65.4 x 58.3 edge to edge, against 65 x 58 measured - inside the 0.5 mm a whole-millimetre reading can hide

releaseChecks.name: the face drops into the shell's recess without interference
releaseChecks.details: -0.0000 mm^3 shared between the face and the shell at 0.15 mm a side

releaseChecks.name: the face lands on the skeleton, not on air
releaseChecks.details: -0.0000 mm^3 of overlap; the face's back plane and the skeleton's front plane are both Z=2.5

releaseChecks.name: the assembled camera is one solid
releaseChecks.details: 1 connected component(s) with all three parts seated

releaseChecks.name: the face finishes flush with the shell's outer surface
releaseChecks.details: face spans Z -3.00..2.50 against a recess 2.5 deep; the bar stands 3 mm proud by design

releaseChecks.name: all four face screws pass through resin into a thread in PETG
releaseChecks.details: 4 clearance holes in the face and 4 M2.5 insert pockets in the skeleton; the resin carries no thread anywhere on this camera

releaseChecks.name: every skeleton feature is coarser than MJF can resolve
releaseChecks.details: pinch ribs 0.5 mm proud, fences 1.5 mm, plate 2.5 mm, against a 0.5 mm smallest resolvable detail and a 1.5 mm recommended wall. The field body's 0.20 mm ribs would not have appeared at all.

releaseChecks.name: the skeleton sits on Z=0 so a viewer opens it the right way up
releaseChecks.details: Z starts at 0.0000

releaseChecks.name: no sealed pocket for unsintered powder to stay in
releaseChecks.details: genus 4: the lens bores are the only tunnels through the part, and every pocket, socket and insert bore opens to the surface

releaseChecks.name: shell has no sealed void for resin to sit in
releaseChecks.details: genus 1: the shell is a tube, open at the front and the rear, so every internal surface drains

releaseChecks.name: face has no sealed void for resin to sit in
releaseChecks.details: genus 8: the face is a plate with four cells and four screw holes, so every internal surface drains

releaseChecks.name: the rear door zone is reserved and clear
releaseChecks.details: Z 61.5..65.5 is empty across the cavity, waiting for the door. The sliding lens cover, the door and the shutter are STAGED - see the README.
